expectations.text: Covers Secure SLC v2.0 (September 28, 2026) and its alignment with Secure Software Standard v2.0 (January 15, 2026)
expectations.evidence: Secure SLC Standard v2.0 (September 28, 2026)... aligns with the Secure Software Standard v2.0, which was published January 15, 2026.

expectations.text: Covers the October 31, 2026 sunsets of 3DS SDK, SPoC and CPoC with their successors (MPoC; Secure Software Standard)
expectations.evidence: The sunset periods for the PCI 3DS SDK, SPoC and CPoC standards ended on October 31, 2026... MPoC is the successor for SPoC and CPoC. 3DS SDK functionality is being folded into the Secure Software Standard.

expectations.text: Covers the September 2026 AI information supplement
expectations.evidence: New information supplement: 'Security Considerations for AI Systems' (September 2026)... guidance, not a requirement.

expectations.text: States v4.0.1 remains current, with the June 3 to July 20, 2026 RFC as input to the next iteration
expectations.evidence: PCI DSS v4.0.1 remains the current version... A Request for Comments on v4.0.1 ran from June 3 to July 20, 2026, as input to the next iteration.

expectations.text: Mentions at least one correctly dated 2026 Community Meeting (such as Europe in Edinburgh, October 20 to 22)
expectations.evidence: No Community Meeting is mentioned anywhere in the briefing.
